environment.working_tree: Modified worktree (50 paths): Products planning/evidence, Catalog adapter/tests and local migrations; no Supabase remote writes or migration applications.

decisions.summary: Products is the user-facing master; retain legacy catalog IDs and CRM EntityRef identities.
Commands derive organization and actor from authenticated context; clients do not choose tenant authority.
Logical DTOs use the approved product class model and a named compatibility mapper for legacy CatalogItem.type values.
Updates and lifecycle/reorder mutations use expected versions; creates and retryable commands use organization-scoped idempotency keys.
Bounded cursor pagination uses default page size 50, maximum 100 and stable deterministic ordering.
Product categories are a first-class logical query/command surface.
All catalog.read roles may read sales prices; purchase costs require catalog.cost.read/manage.
Party-role, availability and eligibility contracts are not promised until their ownership and remote persistence are resolved.
Domain events remain proposed; publish only with approved actor/version/audit and consumer ownership.

Remote writes require operation-specific RLS, cost-specific permissions, optimistic versions, archive-only semantics and the approved atomic Platform audit contract; Products call sites and atomicity tests remain required.
Keep the existing catalog adapter boundary and online-only remote operations; do not introduce an HTTP transport without an approved plan.
Direct users cannot provide product/SKU internal keys or SKUs; a trusted future integration may import an external SKU through a separate boundary.
Cost is queried and mutated through permission-gated per-purchasable-unit contracts, never embedded in ordinary Product DTOs.
Product/SKU media galleries support multiple assignments and manual per-gallery order.
The shared Files boundary is approved; product-media metadata-table enforcement, signed-preview authorization, detach/retention behavior and end-to-end acceptance remain open.
Product and SKU DTOs expose optional per-unit physical attributes in kg/cm without inheritance.
Represent cost amounts as canonical base-10 decimal strings in JSON to avoid binary floating-point loss; ISO-currency scale remains open.
Cost history/source, shared asset tags/renditions, event outbox and exact migration/deployed-state behavior remain unresolved.

actions: Reconciled API contracts with confirmed domain and access decisions for category, SKU, cost, physical-attribute and media behaviors.
Defined separate cost reads/writes gated by catalog.cost.read/manage and excluded cost from ordinary Product DTOs and projections.
Defined logical Product/SKU media commands that reference finalized Platform Files rather than transporting file bytes.
Added atomic full-gallery ordering with expected assignment versions, stable pagination and no partial reorder behavior.
Aligned the proposed product-media event name and safe payload with discovery; excluded file bytes, public URLs and sensitive cost values.
Recorded Files authorization, currency precision/history, tag/rendition ownership, audit and deployed migration state as open dependencies.

Revalidated access-sensitive contracts against access attempt 11: owner/admin-only cost grants, approved Files boundary, outstanding media-table enforcement, and approved audit semantics with missing Products call sites and atomicity tests.

validation.evidence: All 34 delivery state-machine and evidence tests passed.
Delivery ledger validation passed: 8 ledger(s) checked.
Module run validation passed: 110 checkpoint files checked (36 archived legacy records).

validation.command: Review api-contracts.md against access attempt 11 and current migrations
validation.evidence: Cost permissions, shared Files approval, open media-table/signed-preview lifecycle gates, and approved audit semantics versus missing Products integration are distinguished.

requirements.evidence: Logical catalog/category contracts preserve identity and scope; current adapters lack shared versioning and category implementation.
Per-unit cost commands and sensitive DTO boundaries are defined; cost permissions, precision/history and RLS are not implemented.
Optional per-product/per-SKU kg/cm DTO fields are defined; current persistence/UI supports product-level values only.

The shared Files boundary is approved; media metadata-table enforcement, signed-preview authorization, detach/retention acceptance, tags/renditions and current schema version/order fields remain open.
Desktop/mobile share logical operations, errors and pagination; no runtime contract test has been performed.
Contracts preserve the existing catalog_item reference and CRM-owned identity.

evidence.result: Defines operation catalog, DTOs, errors, pagination, idempotency, versioning, events and shared Platform dependencies.
Current CatalogAdapter exposes cost reads/writes without expected versions and no ProductMediaAdapter integration.
Current media contract accepts raw File upload, returns arrays without pagination/version/order, and exposes tags/update/detach/preview.
Cost amount is currently a nullable number and ProductVariant has no explicit physical attributes.
Cost table is product/SKU-addressable but current policy uses broad catalog.write and has no version/history fields.
Media tables have no position/version fields and link to shared Files; migration replaces Storage policies.
Product Owner confirmed manual image ordering for every product/SKU gallery as DOM-ERP-031.
Owner/admin-only cost permissions and the shared Files boundary are confirmed; media metadata/signed-preview enforcement, full deployed RLS and Products audit integration/atomicity remain open gates.
Storage object deletion is denied for product-media paths, but the later migrations do not replace asset/assignment table FOR ALL policies.
The shared append-only audit table/function exist and semantics are approved; Products mutation call sites and atomicity tests are missing.

next_handoff: 05-sync: define retry behavior using the approved Files and audit semantics; preserve cost confidentiality, require reauthorization, and keep remote mutations blocked until RLS and Products audit atomicity evidence pass.
notes: No endpoints, DTO implementations, database schema, migrations or production code were changed in this phase.

The shared Files boundary and append-only audit semantics are approved; media-table enforcement, signed-preview lifecycle, Products audit call sites and atomicity tests remain prerequisites for remote writes.
Costs require owner/admin-only catalog.cost.read/manage and must be absent from all unauthorized DTOs, projections, events and caches.
Gallery order is a confirmed Product Owner requirement; storage needs a migration and optimistic reorder semantics.
Currency-specific decimal scale, cost history/source and asset tag/rendition ownership are explicitly open.
